insight.headline: Taxes Recalculated
insight.what_changed: The orderUpdate GraphQL mutation now recalculates taxes when the shipping address is updated on an unfulfilled order. This change affects the GraphQL Admin API and will be rolled out as of August 31, 2026. Previously, taxes were not recalculated after updating the shipping address.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should be aware of this change when updating orders through the GraphQL Admin API. They should test their apps to ensure they handle the updated tax calculations correctly. This change may require updates to their code, especially if they are using the orderUpdate mutation. The GraphQL Admin API will return the updated tax calculations, so developers should review their code to ensure it can handle these changes.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will see more accurate tax calculations when updating shipping addresses on unfulfilled orders. This change will help merchants avoid potential tax discrepancies and ensure compliance with tax regulations.
insight.why_it_matters: This change improves the accuracy of tax calculations and ensures compliance with tax regulations. It also provides a better experience for merchants and their customers by ensuring that taxes are calculated correctly.

recap.headline: Hydrogen updates and GraphQL Admin API enhancements lead the week

themes.title: Hydrogen Updates
themes.detail: The Hydrogen developer preview has been updated with new capabilities, including Vue bindings, and there have been patch updates to @shopify/cli-hydrogen and @shopify/mini-oxygen. These updates aim to improve the development experience and extend the ways developers can build Shopify storefronts.

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API Enhancements
themes.detail: New fields have been added to the GraphQL Admin API for cash management activities and drawers in POS, providing more detail about cash drawer balances and cash count activities. Additionally, the Customer object in Shopify Functions now includes a createdAt field, and updating an order's shipping address now recalculates taxes.

themes.title: Ecosystem Updates
themes.detail: The shopify-account component is now a Theme Store requirement, and merchants can see partner details on collaborator requests. POS UI extensions can also now print directly to hardware receipt printers using the Printing API.

actions.text: Review and implement the new Hydrogen features and updates
Update code to utilize the new GraphQL Admin API fields and Shopify Functions Customer object field
Ensure compliance with the new Theme Store requirement for the shopify-account component
Test and adapt to the tax recalculation change when updating an order's shipping address
